title: build save has no --confirm: the flag is an unknown argument, with or without a value, even next to --yes; nothing is shown or saved
source: intended: docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut" (build save asks on a terminal or takes --yes): a draft becomes a build only with the owner's OK, which is a terminal answer or --yes; the guard denies the agent
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut"). The confirmation token is gone, so `--confirm` is a flag `build save` does not take: `JITSO REJECTED: unknown argument "--confirm"`, exit 2, with nothing on stdout, nothing written and the draft kept. It is refused before the draft is read, so it is the same with a value, without one, and next to `--yes`.
